clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money beginning in March 1988 and her distance from your father over it by May 1988, her move to distance continuing; your brother's grades fell by November 1989; and your mother grew calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts pile up across the death and settle by spring 1990.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1994–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother Della's diagnosis of breast cancer in February 1995, within the months after: you had migraines keeping you in bed from March 1994, called your brother most nights from April 1994, then stopped returning his calls by June 1995 and stopped calling home by February 1996. Your moves toward and then away from your brother, beside your mother's illness, show the family's shift in those months, and the distance settles by 1996.
